description: Northern Territory Government Open Data Portal is a data portal run by Northern Territory Government. The portal lists open data sets of the territory in transport, water, power, emergency services and land, with downloads and map services. Coverage: Northern Territory. It is reached online through the home page and its search, download or service pages, in forms such as csv, shp; access is free of charge and open to view; downloads may need a free account. The licence is: terms set by the site, not read in this search. Caveats: the home page was opened on 2026-09-30 and only its title ("Welcome - NTG Open Data Portal") was read, so the holdings, the current terms and the availability of downloads were not browsed, and this description rests on the agency's publicly documented role and may lag the site. It can support remote infrastructure and hazard studies of the Northern Territory. Related records: data-au-nt-strike-northern-territory-mines, data-au-nt-strike-northern-territory-geological-faults-2500k are catalogued from the same site.
